instruction: I prefer the full VLC interface with all controls visible. Can you disable minimal view mode in VLC settings?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view=0 in vlcrc config file). Similar difficulty to original task - both involve changing a single VLC preference setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable minimal view mode
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC config file from appropriate OS location
Metric (check_qt_minimal_view) correctly parses config file and checks qt-minimal-view setting
Expected value (0) correctly represents disabled minimal view mode
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure settings are persisted and can be verified
Logic handles edge case where setting is not explicitly in config file (uses default value 0)
Complete coverage: single requirement (disable minimal view) is fully verified
Error handling is present for file not found and general exceptions
